title: PeopleHub — Export Everyone
objective: The directory page shows only your own organization's staff. The export feature behind it doesn't know the difference.

verifier.condition: A CSV export requested by a member of one organization contains a row belonging to a different organization.

weakness: The paginated directory view correctly scopes results to the caller's own organization, but the separate bulk-export endpoint behind the 'Export CSV' button iterates every record in the system with no organization filter at all.
vulnerableEndpoint: GET /api/export/employees.csv (no organization scoping of any kind)
seededData: Two organizations, Acme and Globex, each with their own staff list. In-memory.

credentials.label: Acme staff account
credentials.note: The directory page only ever shows Acme's own staff.

hints: Browse the directory page normally and confirm it only ever shows your own organization's people.
Find the 'Export CSV' button and look at exactly which endpoint it calls — is it the same one the directory page itself uses?
A feature that exports 'everything' sometimes means exactly that, regardless of which page links to it.
burpNotes: Sign in and call the export endpoint directly in Repeater, comparing its output against the directory page's own scoped list.
